taskProofs.prompt: @nodeagent  Use the uploaded input artifacts and the current live room sheet. Check the revenue change, identify evidence that supports it, and preserve the human-entered C2 value. Ground the answer in visible room evidence and uploaded files. Make the smallest necessary sheet edits; avoid bulk updates unless the task truly requires them.
